Subject: Exploring New Opportunities Together

Hi Vinicius,

Thank you once again for the opportunity to collaborate on the El Salvador FSO project. It was a pleasure working alongside your team, and I truly value the partnership we've built.

Since our last conversation, we've refined our offerings and identified three specific areas where we can create mutual benefits:

1. **Managed AI Support Automation** — We can deploy our AI agents to manage Tier-1 and Tier-2 tickets, significantly reducing response times by over 60%. This service can be co-branded, allowing you to maintain your client relationships while we handle the AI delivery.

2. **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments** — We can package the audit framework we discussed into a repeatable, co-branded offering. You would lead the commercial conversations while we provide the technical depth, with a 50/50 revenue split on net margins.

3. **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot** — We propose a 30-day pilot using your current environment alongside our platform. This will demonstrate measurable reductions in MTTR and cloud cost savings, with a seamless transition to an MSA/SOW-1 post-pilot at pre-agreed pricing.

I believe these initiatives can drive significant value for both our teams. I’d love to discuss these ideas further and see which direction resonates most with you. We can continue our conversation via email or schedule a quick call to finalize the details. Here’s my Calendly link for your convenience: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup.

Additionally, I encourage you to explore the free tools and services available on our website, which your team can start utilizing right away: https://ziontechgroup.com.

Looking forward to your thoughts!
